description: The world database has been corrupted by a failed data import operation. Using MySQL Workbench connected to the local MySQL server (host: localhost, user: ga, password: password123), perform a comprehensive data quality audit of the city table: identify all referential integrity violations where city.CountryCode does not match any row in the country table, identify and eliminate all exact duplicate city records (same Name, CountryCode, and District), and fix all cities with a Population value of exactly 0 by deleting them (population=0 is invalid for any recorded city). After cleaning the data, export the complete set of cities whose country is on the continent 'South America' to /home/ga/Documents/exports/south_america_cities.csv. The export must include all city columns (ID, Name, CountryCode, District, Population).
